title: Australian Zesty Keto Soup
description: A low-carb, keto-friendly soup made with fresh Australian ingredients and a zesty twist.
instructions: Heat the low-carb soup broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped fresh zesty herbs and let simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced Australian tomato and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and let simmer for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Optional: Add a sprinkle of grated cheese or a dollop of sour cream for extra flavor.
